description: This file defines the EmployeeEducationSearchFilterParams class, which extends a base FilterParams class. It appears to be a Data Transfer Object (DTO) used for specifying search filter parameters for employee education data within the OrangeHRM system. The class includes a property for employee number and sets a default sort field.

classes.description: A DTO class for employee education search filters, allowing to specify filtering parameters such as employee number and sort field.
